questions.stem: All the following statements regarding sutures are true except

options.label: A
options.text: The integrity of polypropylene sutures in holding tissues together can last indefinitely

options.label: B
options.text: Braided suture material may be a nidus for infection.

options.label: C
options.text: Polymeric synthetic suture materials causes minimal inflammatory reaction.

options.label: D
options.text: Monofilament non absorbable sutures are easy to use in tying secure knots.
